extraction_notes: Main-text performance figures are Figure 1 and Figure 2 on page 4. Figures 3–5 are XRD/XPS characterization and were skipped. Figure 2 reports CH4 productivity versus CO2 conversion; the provided schema has no field for CH4 productivity, so those y-values are preserved in record notes. Individual point temperatures in Figure 2 are not labelled, although the paper states catalysts were tested between 175 and 250 °C. Some near-zero markers in Figure 2 overlap at the baseline; only points that could be assigned to a legend entry by colour were recorded.
